overview_description.description: Odeko is a software platform that assists small businesses in managing their operations and inventory while providing tools for order fulfillment, customer engagement, and data analytics to enhance decision-making and streamline processes. The platform offers features such as inventory tracking, supply chain management, and sales reporting, enabling businesses to operate efficiently and effectively in a competitive market. Additionally, Odeko supports integration with various payment systems and delivery services, facilitating a seamless experience for both business owners and their customers.

about_short_description.short_description: Odeko provides software for coffee shops, streamlining inventory, ordering, and delivery to reduce operational costs.

product.name: Smart Operations Platform
product.description: Software for independent cafés and eateries to manage purchasing, inventory needs, vendor orders, and operational data through a customizable dashboard.

product.name: Supply Marketplace and Catalog
product.description: A marketplace and catalog of café ingredients, beverages, paper goods, barista supplies, and other operating products sourced from national and local brands.

product.name: Overnight Delivery and Restocking
product.description: A delivery service that consolidates café supply orders and delivers ingredients, beverages, baked goods, and operating supplies overnight, including direct-to-shop placement.

product.name: Mobile Ordering and Rewards
product.description: An app and online ordering service that lets café customers place orders ahead of time and participate in the shop’s rewards program.
